title: Scroll Firepit
html:
Monster drop: Dune Raider

How to get it

Teaches Firepit, a level-3 Fire spell. Needs 30 Intellect and Fire skill 15 to learn and to cast.

Drops from monsters that cast Fire spells, level 18+.

  • A monster that casts spells drops scrolls of its own school, so look for Fire casters.
  • The monster’s level picks the spell level: 8+ drops level-2 scrolls, 18+ level-3 and 30+ level-4.
